overview: Clouds you can land on. From the ground they are weather and nothing else, but plant a magic bean and a beanstalk grows up to whatever is sitting on the cloud layer above you.

1.1.0: The village talks about the sky. Villagers have lines about the two kinds of kingdom that give themselves away from below - a tarn that rains out of its underside and a forge that smokes - and nobody down there ever learns there is a place up there.
Cloud block and bean drops tidied up.
1.0.0: Seven tiers overhead: bank, tarn, spire, forge, homestead, citadel and wreck, each with its own chests and its own garrison, from axolotls and frogs on a tarn to a giant guarding a citadel's vault.
Magic beans grow a climbable beanstalk to reach them, and there is no throwaway tier - getting onto any cloud at all costs a bean.
